description: Figure 5 presents a comparative error analysis between the Vanilla model and the HCL model, displayed as two separate pie charts. The left chart, representing the Vanilla model, shows the distribution of errors across four categories: "Atomic Skill Fail" (68.0%, dark blue), "Correct" (12.0%, medium blue), "Reason Error" (8.0%, light blue), and "Question Misunderstood" (12.0%, grey). The right chart, for the HCL model, shows a different distribution: "Atomic Skill Fail" (55.0%, dark blue), "Correct" (21.0%, medium blue), "Reason Error" (14.0%, light blue), and "Question Misunderstood" (10.0%, grey). Both charts are color-coded with a legend at the top, and the percentage for each segment is explicitly labeled within the pie slice.
